name: Hertwill – EU and US Dropshipping
author: Hertwill

sections.description:
Dropship premium products from European and US brands at wholesale prices. With the Hertwill plugin, you can seamlessly import products to your store, get automatic stock updates, and enjoy automated order fulfillment. Hertwill is built for one thing: offering only high-quality products.

Start Free

Start your dropshipping journey with our Free Plan. Or try any paid plan with a trial. Paid plans let you add more products to your store and give you lower wholesale prices.

Winning Products

All our products come from European and US brands, with many made locally. No AliExpress or Shein junk. Every item comes with a 2-year warranty and is backed by trusted brands, so you can sell with confidence. Hertwill is for merchants who want to sell awesome products, not random cheap stuff.

Fulfillment & Quick Delivery

Let us handle the logistics. We manage all orders, so you don’t need your own warehouse or inventory. Our products ship from European and US warehouses, ensuring fast delivery. And unlike most other dropshipping apps, we accept returns—but there aren’t many because our products are just that good.

Product Information and Marketing Content

Gain access to detailed product images and descriptions, plus professional marketing pictures, videos, and reviews.

You Are Not Alone

Hertwill is more than just a dropshipping app—we’re your partner. We’re committed to supporting and working alongside online stores, guiding you toward success every step of the way. Not only do we offer tips and feedback, but we also connect you with other like-minded merchants. Plus, we provide all our subscribers with the most thorough ecommerce checklist on the market, giving you an even better chance to succeed.
sections.faq:
Is Hertwill free?

Hertwill offers a free plan with no credit card required. We also offer paid plans for merchants who are serious about building their business, want to add more products, and get lower wholesale prices. Check Hertwill’s plans here. Every paid plan comes with a free trial, and you can cancel anytime.

What makes Hertwill different from other dropshipping plugins?

All the products we offer come from high-quality European and US brands. We focus on quality, and we’re the only dropshipping app on the market doing that. Hertwill was started because we wanted to dropship awesome products from real brands but couldn’t find an app that offered it—so we built Hertwill.

Do I need a Hertwill account to use the Hertwill WooCommerce plugin?

Yes, a Hertwill account is required to use our WooCommerce plugin. You can easily create a free account by visiting our website.

How much are top stores making partnering with Hertwill?

Top stores are making over €300K annually.

Can I sell products provided by Hertwill if I am already selling products from other suppliers?

Yes.

In which regions is Hertwill available?

Hertwill is available for online stores that sell to the European Union, United Kingdom, and United States. Read more detailed information on the Shipping page.

What is dropshipping?

Dropshipping is an order fulfillment method where a store doesn’t keep the products it sells in stock. Instead, the seller purchases inventory as needed from a third party—usually a wholesaler or manufacturer—to fulfill orders. In short, the order will be shipped directly to the end customer after you make the sale. All the products we provide at Hertwill are available via dropshipping.
